init_study_paths: create a StudyPaths instance with a study key to resolve folder, download, and preprocessed paths
match_list_delete_replacements: match two lists of different sizes using Levenshtein edit distance and delete replacement items from both
match_list_keep_replacements: match two lists of different sizes using Levenshtein edit distance and keep replacement items in both
get_study_download_path: get the download sub-path from a StudyPaths instance for a given study key
get_study_preprocessed_path: get the preprocessed sub-path from a StudyPaths instance for a given study key
